text:
No candle close through the line, no entry.

Free 9 EMA Grok bot template:
1. Scans your watchlist for 9 EMA pullbacks
2. Ticket: entry, stop, swing target, invalidation
3. Sizes from your risk %, or blocks
4. No setup? It says so

https://t.co/L3iQfOTyFW

Not advice. https://t.co/C9m5AHa8al

mediaDetails.ext_alt_text: Card for the free 9 EMA Grok bot template. Four features: close-through entries only (a wick touch is logged as no entry), a full ticket with entry, stop, swing target and invalidation close, sizing from your risk percent or SIZE: BLOCKED, and a no-setup board when nothing qualifies. Writes tickets only, places no orders. Not advice. Right side: an illustrative candle chart where price pulls back to the 9 EMA, one wick pokes above the dotted entry line (marked wick, no entry), then a candle closes through it (marked ENTERED).
